purpose: Freeze an apparatus-resolved source-line-valve-terminal release model and its data contract before opening an independent facility logger archive.
claim_boundary: This artifact is a reproducibility and data-acquisition protocol. It is not external validation, does not repair the frozen Proust holdout, and does not support a safety-distance or controller claim.

source_target.title: High pressure hydrogen fires

published_apparatus_description.source_vessel: 25 L Type-IV hydrogen vessel, initially near 90 MPa
published_apparatus_description.supply_line: 10 m line with nominal 10 mm diameter
published_apparatus_description.terminal_orifices: 1 mm, 2 mm and 3 mm nominal diameters
reported_observations: temperature immediately upstream of the terminal restriction

derived_geometry.use_rule: Do not treat this value as a measured logger channel or as a confirmatory calibration target; replace it with as-built bore and measured dead volume when available.

source_target.rights_note: The conference PDF is publicly readable, but no data-redistribution licence was identified. Store citation, extraction metadata and derived metrics only; do not commit the PDF or redistribute publisher figures.

state_description: source vessel mass and internal energy
one or more physically declared line or manifold mass and internal-energy states
finite upstream valve flow and bidirectional inter-volume restriction flows
cumulative terminal mass/enthalpy and net thermal-boundary energy bookkeeping, which does not feed the physical trajectory
locked_model.parameter_policy: Freeze geometry, valve opening law, discharge coefficients, heat-transfer terms, solver tolerances and boundary semantics before any target-campaign numerical result is inspected.

locked_evaluator.initial_state_policy: Use the first synchronized pressure, temperature and ambient sample as a boundary condition; never fit geometry, coefficients, valve travel, crop or time shift against outcomes.
locked_evaluator.archive_policy: Persist aliases, hashes, aggregate metrics and all failed-case reasons; never persist raw rows, paths, facility identity, exact dates or manufacturer details.

protocol_revision.change_scope: Before any qualifying target campaign was received, the single line volume was generalized to physically declared line/manifold volumes separated by explicit equivalent restrictions, and the valve travel law gained a frozen shape exponent. The one-volume default preserves the earlier equations. New profile outputs make distributed inventory and pressure loss directly testable.

required_channels.name: line_pressure_pa_abs
required_channels.role: line inventory and valve transient state

known_source_gap.decision: The published Proust curves remain a local-aperture supplementary holdout. A future apparatus-resolved confirmatory run requires a new rights-cleared logger archive or a new experiment containing the full required channel contract.

freeze_sequence: Register as-built source volume, line bore, line length, dead volume, valve Cv or equivalent opening law, terminal bore and sensor calibration certificates.
Hash the model source, configuration, solver version and raw logger archive before numerical rows are opened.
Define time synchronization, missing-data, sensor-quality and uncertainty rules without inspecting model residuals.
Pre-register primary endpoints, thresholds and a minimum number of complete runs.
Run the frozen model once on the locked archive; no case-specific coefficient, time shift, cropping or diameter-specific fitting is allowed.
Archive every failed run and report channel-level reasons for ineligibility.

quality_controls.uncertainty_policy: Report logger calibration uncertainty and digitization uncertainty separately; propagate both to endpoint intervals without using intervals to override a failed primary screen.

primary_endpoints.aggregate_rule: At least eight declared cases must span two source-pressure, two geometry and two valve-opening groups; at least 70 percent must pass every quality, primary and conservation gate. Numerical failures and missing-channel cases remain in the denominator.

promotion_gate.current_ijhe_submission_readiness: This protocol alone cannot make the manuscript submission-ready.
